worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.summary: Burst a ring of brilliant light outward from the user: every enemy the light sweeps takes special damage and has a high chance to lose 1 stage of Sp. Def, leaving a ring of dazzle on those it lowers.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.use.0: Cover a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.use.1: Lower the Sp. Def of nearby foes with the family's highest chance
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.descriptio: The light deals %1$s special damage to each target it sweeps.
The light spreads %1$s blocks from the user, reaching full size in %2$s.
On hit there is a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s); the dazzle lingers for %3$s.
The burst throws about %1$s beams; focused form is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.growth.0: From level %1$s the light rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of radius.
worldcombat.skill.lusterpurge.preference: On: radius ×0.78, power ×1.18, sunder chance +0.06, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown — for single targets. Off: the light spreads at the base radius with base power and chance, engulfing a whole ring when surrounded.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it approach from further away before releasing.
On: when other enemies stand around it, it prioritizes the light ring, covering several at once. Off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
